scope: Q7 v1.01 FIPLIB FC1 coefficient selection, pass configuration, wrapper export and HDR-specific input provenance.

hdr_case.path: PerformImageMixSubImages 0x80b29640 selects the traced work+0x208 == 0 branch at 0x80b29b9c and calls IpuToneMapRgb 0x80b1c104 at 0x80b29de0 with format 0x0f01.
hdr_case.fresh_processor: IpuToneMapRgb uses PathCreate(0,...). ConvertPathInit registers Create 0x801bcc48 for this path; Create allocates a processor via IpuCreate 0x801d0894 and stores it at path+0x880. CImageProcessor constructor clears the descriptor slots; SetDefaults installs only IDs 0xf and 0x19.
hdr_case.submitted_descriptors: IpuToneMapRgb passes the HDR auxiliary descriptor from work+0x228, creates gamma ID 0xa/version 9, and creates FC1 descriptor ID 0xf/version 0xc. For the traced HDR producer the auxiliary descriptor is ID 0x1f/version 0xc: HdrImageMixing constructs that header on its local path, while HdrSetZLightFilter validates ID 0x1f/version 0xc/size 0x1060 before copying into the same cache. Path filter translation only remaps 0xc8/0xca/0xcb/0xcc.
hdr_case.selector: PrepareCalculations zeroes its input structure. It writes input+1 from the low byte of descriptor ID 0x1d +0x18 only if that descriptor slot exists (descriptors+0x15c). No traced initializer or call on this fresh HDR path supplies ID 0x1d, so input+1 stays zero. OverrideInputAPI does not modify this byte.

source.conversion: Version 0xc uses shift zero and companion scale 1 plus offset 0. The first nine coefficients and two companion halfwords are copied unchanged to input+0x1074..+0x1088.

hdr_case.conclusion: On this fresh HDR path, each kind-0 IPU wrapper that reaches the traced FC1 analysis/export path receives the same eleven values, encoded as sign-extended 32-bit words. This establishes numerical preservation across that software path; the earlier FC1 setter still replaces the object fields when its separate update gate is met.

pass_dispatch.wrapper: FipLibCalculate 0x8017c9f8 computes pass count/type with CalcNPasses, allocates a 0x24-stride returned wrapper array and a 0xc-stride internal output-record array. For kind 0 the internal record+8 and wrapper+0x1c share the pointer to the allocated 0x5e0 IPU payload. Kind 1 has a separate 0x40 IPS payload and uses IPS methods.
pass_dispatch.direct_and_cop: With low byte of FipLibCalculate third argument zero it calls CFIPLIB::Analyze then Export directly. Nonzero selects COP command 1. ThrIpuCop dispatches command 1 to CopPathAnalyze 0x8017c9b8, which calls the same Analyze and Export entry points.
pass_dispatch.analysis: CFIPLIB::AnalyzePasses 0x8017b23c visits selected pass objects (selection array null or byte nonzero) and calls pass vtable+8 with the FIPLIB input and pass topology parameters. FipLibCalculate sets every allocated entry of the selection array to 1. Export requires internal record+4 and +8 both non-null and dispatches pass vtable+0xc.
pass_dispatch.prepare: For the base implementation and three IPU overrides of PreparePassInParams_Misc, input+1 != 1 binds input+0x1074 to pass+0x8f4, and nulls pass+0x8f8. input+1 == 1 nulls +0x8f4 and puts that pointer at +0x8f8. Relative to the IPU pass input base pass+0x88c, these are +0x68 and +0x6c respectively.

fc1_generator.construction: Base IPU pass constructor sets mode 1 for block at pass+0x118. The FC constructor stores the mode at block+0x26. FC blocks at pass+0x684/+0x6b0/+0x6dc use modes 2/3/4 and export into other payload ranges.
fc1_generator.configuration: IPU pass analysis at 0x80178490 calls PreparePassInParams via vtable+0x1c, then enters Config 0x801783cc. Config passes block=pass+0x118 and local input=pass+0x88c to FC ConfigIntRegs 0x8017ab94. Mode 1 with a non-null local input+0x68 pointer copies eleven consecutive halfwords into block+0x10..+0x24. There is no coefficient multiplication, shift or clamp in this branch.
fc1_generator.fallback: Mode 1 with a null local input+0x68 does not consume the supplied matrix. It selects ITU-R 601 RGB-to-YUV 0x8017a99c when local input+0x64 is zero, or ITU-R 709 RGB-to-YUV 0x8017aa7c otherwise. Local input+0x64 comes from FIPLIB input+0x108b in all four misc implementations; PrepareCalculations zeroes it for descriptor version 0xc. Routing the pointer to local+0x6c is separate from FC1 and the mode-3 block uses that pointer.
fc1_generator.export: IPU pass Export 0x801784c0 reads the internal record payload pointer at +8 and calls FC Export 0x8017ad04 with block=pass+0x118 and destination=payload+0x100. Export sign-extends eleven signed halfwords into 32-bit words at payload+0x100..+0x128, including the two 0x800 companions at +0x124/+0x128 for this HDR input.
fc1_generator.packed_flags: Mode 1 copies local input+0x28 (pass+0x8b4) to block+0xc and clears block+0xd. Export writes (block+0xc & 1) | ((block+0xd & 0xf) << 1) into payload+0x12c, so the observed mode-1 expression is pass+0x8b4 & 1. The actual per-pass bit is separate from the eleven literal values.
fc1_generator.enable: FC1 enable is separately resolved from payload+0x44. Top BlockControls writes pass+0x8b0 (local top+0x24), ConfigIntRegs_Bypasses 0x80179cac copies it to general block+0x3f, and general Export 0x80179f90 writes that byte as the low byte of payload+0x44. Base and overridden top methods differ; e.g. 1x0 forces 1 while 1x1 and 0x1 consult input+0x1072 in one branch. The translator enables FC1 iff payload+0x44 byte is zero.
fc1_generator.downstream: FIPLIB wrapper ID 0xab/version 0xc dispatches to CFc1Filter::SetFilterFipLibData12 at 0x8031f64c when the update gate is met. It stores the low 16 bits from payload+0x100..+0x128 and packed flags from +0x12c. The direct writer sign-extends the halfwords again; the CBC path builds address/value chunks from the same object.

limitations: Fresh HDR preservation refers to the traced initializers and descriptor producers. External modifications or a different descriptor/topology route may change selector, enable and output.
The copied eleven values do not establish the actual selected pass count, per-pass bypass and packed control values, final submission, or image output from a real capture.
The IPS wrapper class does not use the IPU FC1 payload layout; other IPU color conversion blocks use separate payload ranges.
Static evidence identifies the algorithm and its conditions. The compact FC replay is a separate artifact; neither camera execution nor ISP pixel arithmetic is reproduced by this evidence.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.
